elements_selected.content: `/enroll.html` static page per REQ-3404 for hardened mode. Self-contained HTML + JS (no network to zetl endpoints). Accepts `?cohort=<cohort-id>` query param. Calls navigator.credentials.create with per-cohort PRF salt `SHA-256('zetl/webauthn-prf/v1/' || origin || '/' || cohort_id)` per REQ-3414. Derives X25519 keypair via typage's PRF-recipient helpers. Displays derived pubkey as `age-recipient-v1:<b64url>` with copy-to-clipboard and QR code affordances. Clear diagnostic for no-PRF scenarios.
